reason: COMPLEX. The first thing I noticed was the QR code and the "every batch lab-tested" line on the box, which my $15 flash-sale bottles never have. I already take a multi-form magnesium, so the 3-form one fits, and sachets are easy to toss in my bag on workdays, but I would only buy one box to try.
objection: It is double what I pay now, and I have a drawer of half-used bottles. Will I actually feel a difference in sleep or cramps, or is this just nicer packaging?
would_change_my_mind: A real review from someone who took it for a few weeks and slept better, or a small trial size or discount on the first box.
